actors.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent sprite atlas for the game 妖怪夜市. Reference image is STYLE only: match its painterly, textured Chinese folklore ghoul, ragged cloth, dusty olive grey skin, warm rim light and restrained cold fill. Side-view high three-quarter camera, all poses face LEFT, one consistent character identity. Full body, transparent backgrounds in every cell, no ground, no labels, no borders. Every cell exactly equal grid size, character completely contained in cell with clear transparent margins; equal body scale and common ground baseline. Keep character silhouette readable at 110 pixels high. Detailed hand-painted raster art, no pixel art, no photoreal photograph, no modern technology. Asset: 4 columns x 4 rows of FOUR distinct sequential animation key poses in EACH row. Character: 盗烬客, a thin, stooped night-market incense thief, ragged patched brown short robe, long sneaky fingers, cloth scarf over balding head, a cracked jade-green ceramic incense pot slung across chest, dark red waist cord, small copper coin clasp. One bent leg, anxious sideways eyes, sly ghoul, no cute plant face. Row 1: four phases of slow shuffling WALK, alternating feet with visible small weight shifts. Row 2: four phases of ATTACK, lean forward, grasp, contact, recoil. Row 3: four phases of STEAL: stops, opens ceramic pot, cups fingers around pot mouth as amber wisps of incense spiral INTO pot, tucks lid closed. Row 4: four phases of DEATH: startled, slumps, folds down, lies still clutching cracked pot. Produce exactly 16 separate complete silhouettes on a 4 by 4 regular grid. Transparent alpha, no contact shadow; do not include other characters. Entire atlas, not a presentation mockup.
